note: Follows authored hose spline anchors; accepts a record-change event only for the expected D-linked hotspot or first-hotspot marker; stores mode-scaled M_SpotTime at +0x1A84 before state 4 copies it to the countdown. Pressure alias effects on stream geometry and 10-to-40 contact padding are now traced; exact scheduler cadence and rendered-water appearance remain open.

label: BeginWindowFireDouse
note: Sets the linked douse-progress gate, initializes the WindowFire ramp and timer, and updates its geometry.

label: CompleteHoseStageWin
note: Emits RC_HoseLvlWin, stores PlayerHose result 1 at +0x198, and enters state 6.

label: CompleteHoseStageLose
note: Emits RC_HoseLvlLose, stores PlayerHose result 2 at +0x198, and enters state 6.

label: BuildChatterSoundSetsForKey
note: Reads the configured sound-set entries for one chatter key and creates a TChatterSet object per entry. Hose-key runtime lookup and cursor playback are traced through 004897C0 and 00489110; the exact configured sound names remain open.

label: RequestHoseTimeWarning
note: Receives the decremented hotspot countdown and passes it with threshold 5 to 00481F40; the helper's six-to-five floored-value transition returns the low-byte gate that requests RC_HoseTimeWarn. Wall-clock units and audible result remain unverified.

label: CheckTimedChatterBoundary
note: Shared timer/helper path floors current value and stored marker +0x278; the PlayerHose caller's threshold 5 yields a low-byte event when current floor is 5 and stored floor is 6. The generic PlayerStatus caller has different timer inputs; exact wall-clock units and audible resource selection remain unverified.

label: RotateBasisByAxisAngleDegrees
note: Rotates matrix basis using half-angle sine/cosine after multiplying the input by the degrees-to-radians constant. PlayerHose feeds pitch/yaw angle values to this helper, confirming their units are degrees.

label: FloorDoubleTowardNegativeInfinity
note: Returns the mathematical floor of finite double inputs, including rounding negative fractional values downward; 00481F40 uses it to compare current and stored countdown boundaries.

label: BuildPlayerHoseSplinePath
note: Traverses the registered RCS_CamHose node chain from PlayerHose +0x194 and fills spline records; data binding to the exported BSP HosePath graph remains open.

label: InitializeTimedSplinePath
note: Allocates 32-byte control records and 16-byte samples for the requested subdivision count; PlayerHose requests ten subdivisions and a closed path.

label: BuildTimedSplineSamples
note: Builds the cached spline sample array and cumulative distance/time fields for open or closed paths; exact polynomial semantics and authored units remain unnamed.

label: AppendSplineControlRecord
note: Stores supplied control values, node pointer, and LookAtPoint XYZ in one 32-byte record; finalizes when the requested record count is reached.

label: SampleSplinePosition
note: Accepts normalized input in [0,1], scales by path duration, and linearly interpolates adjacent 16-byte XYZ/time samples.

label: SampleSplineLookAtAndAnchor
note: Interpolates the time-indexed LookAt and returns the selected control record exactly when its address differs from the cache; then stores the selected address as the cache.

label: PlayerHoseEntityConstructor
note: Validates and stores a 20-byte UserData pointer, then seeds PlayerHose origin from UserData +4/+8/+C; +0x10 is strongly mapped to authored FirstPathPoint by route reads and BSP data.

label: ValidateTypedEntityUserData
note: Copies the create-input UserData pointer and validates its byte size against the registered entity class size; PlayerHose requires 0x14 bytes.

label: AllocatePlayerHoseEntity
note: Allocates a 0x1A88-byte PlayerHose object and calls constructor 00468050 with the entity creation input.

label: SubtractRailCameraOrigin
note: Computes the component-wise first vector minus the second; PlayerHose uses target and rail position inputs for its view-direction vector.

label: WriteTimestampedHoseStreamSample
note: Writes a timestamped source position, stored aim-velocity vector, and separate shape scalar into bounded circular samples at the configured interval; 0046BC10 interpolates these records and 0046C5A0 consumes their path geometry.

label: InterpolateTimestampedHoseSample
note: Interpolates source, aim velocity, and shape at the requested history time. The main point is source + velocity*age + half gravity*age^2; the secondary strip curve uses (velocity + (0,-500,0)) at 0.6*age with the same half-gravity term. Also returns the main path tangent used by collision-response effects.

label: AppendHoseStreamCurvePoint
note: Appends a stream-curve point and associated shape scalar to parallel arrays; 0046C5A0 supplies twice the interpolated sample shape scalar, not normalized pressure.

label: InterpolateHoseSampleRecord
note: Interpolates timestamped sample vectors and the final shape scalar field; the stream consumer uses that scalar for its segment threshold and curve-helper input.

label: InitializeHoseSampleHistory
note: Initializes the bounded timestamped sample history with a 0.75-second lifetime, 0.1-second interval, eight records, and gravity vector (0,-2000,0); 0046D1B0 appends pressure-scaled source/velocity/shape records through 0046C000.

label: ClearCulledHoseStripPolygon
note: Replaces the four strip vertices with out-of-view values and submits them to the polygon, clearing a section after its shape threshold fails or the earlier section hits the world.

label: ResolveRendererTextureResourceId
note: Searches the selected renderer resource array for the requested numeric ID and returns its texture pointer; the PlayerHose strip requests ID 3. A missing ID logs an undefined-texture diagnostic and returns null.

label: BuildHoseSprayAttachmentListFromCommand
note: Scales touchhose N by 24, divides by the embedded attachment state +0x40 (HoseSpray owner +0xCB0), converts toward zero through 004B9400, and passes the resulting record count to 00485D20.

label: ResizeHoseSprayAttachmentList
note: Frees and rebuilds the intrusive HoseSpray attachment list when its requested count changes; allocates and links the requested number of 0x30-byte records. Record purpose remains unknown.

label: ValidateParticleEffectTrackIndex
note: Checks a track key index against the current key-list length; non-looping indices clamp to the final key while loop-enabled indices wrap.

label: EvaluateParticleColorTrackValues
note: Converts track outputs to bytes through 004B9400; the optional override branch tests flags 0x6, which are clear for HoseSpray configured flags 0x8.

label: InitializeAnimatedSpriteParticle
note: Initializes particle state and track, sets particle +0xA8 scale to 1.0, and zeros velocity/acceleration before child-specific setup. FireRescue sprite construction also sets child +0xD4 to zero before the first alpha update; +0xD0 is not initialized in the inspected constructor path.

label: UpdateParticlePoolEntries
note: Iterates the configured particle pool and calls 0047F960 once per entry; the caller scheduler cadence remains unresolved.

label: UpdateSelectedLevelProfileOnWin
note: Win-only result consumer looks up the selected catalog ordinal, obtains or creates its profile record, and updates record fields. Exact schema and progression semantics remain unresolved.

label: ResetFrontendStateForResult
note: Called by both result-state branches; resets frontend display/navigation fields and restores the 640x480 menu viewport before selecting the next page.

label: ClearFrontendNavigationHistory
note: Clears ten menu-child history entries and resets the history cursor before switching to the result-selected child.

label: ConstructFrontendChild5
note: Menu child 5 creates two button widgets and requests resource 54; hash-pinned menu.rrf and the asset manifest map the request to leftarrow.bmp/leftarrow_a.bmp. The page label, controls, content, and purpose remain unidentified.

label: ReadDirectInputMouseRelativeDeltas
note: Resets X/Y accumulators each poll and sums signed DirectInput relative event data for offsets 0 and 4.

label: RegisterMouseRelativeAxes
note: Registers MOUSE_X and MOUSE_Y as type-2 axes 0 and 1.

label: ReadInputActionAxisSum
note: Resolves a named axis action, invokes each bound control getter, and sums the returned values.

label: ConstructInputActionMap
note: Initializes the STEER_YAW and STEER_PITCH axis actions and binds them to control indices 0 and 1; function also constructs other input actions.

label: LookupRendererTextureResource
note: Selects the active renderer resource array and delegates the numeric key to 00493650; PlayerHose constructor 0046D6B0 requests key 3.

label: AddPlayerBonusPoints
note: Adds the signed script argument to the global Bonus Points statistic through 00486980, then sends Player event 7.

label: AddNamedResultStatistic
note: Looks up the named statistic and adds the amount to its wrapping 32-bit value word; the decompiler temporary base is offset by 0xC from the record.

label: FormatPlayerBonusWidget
note: Formats the signed statistic with %i and sends the parent-derived bounds and value to text child +0x130; glyph metrics are mapped but final placement and alignment remain unresolved.

label: FUN_00455de0
note: Configures resource-502 Bonus Points sprite crop and animation track, selects text style 3, and sets the child's 0.65 parameter; coordinate mapping and render-state meaning remain unresolved.

label: FUN_00455f10
note: Restarts the Bonus Points widget clock and resets its interpolation state to the zero-time sample.

label: FUN_00455c00
note: Updates the Bonus Points sprite animation from its source track; viewport corner mapping remains unresolved.

label: FUN_0048ab40
note: Accepts the 0.65 text-child parameter from Bonus Points setup; its final material/render-state effect is not established.

label: FUN_0048abb0
note: Selects text style index 3 for the Bonus Points child; the configured profile maps to resource 64000.

label: FUN_0048ae20
note: Maps the configured printable-ASCII profile to 8x14 glyph cells in a 16-column atlas; final per-widget placement remains unresolved.

label: FUN_0048b7c0
note: Draws the generic text component through the configured font profile; retail material and screen-output parity remain unverified.

label: FUN_0048c2a0

label: InitializeFireRescueVisualChildSlots
note: Initializes the four embedded child pointers to null before FireRescue visual setup.

label: InitializeSpriteBase
note: Base sprite setup binds descriptor and transform state; inspected instructions do not initialize alpha override +0xD0/+0xD4.

label: ConstructFireRescueSprite
note: Constructs the sprite and invokes 0047F500; no direct +0xD0 alpha initialization appears in the constructor.
